environment: offline .NET IFix VM; includes test doubles, not iOS measurements
interpretation: ESP temporary allocation churn is reduced, not eliminated. This fixture shows no growing retained collection after full GC. It does not prove an on-device native crash cause or a device memory ceiling.
collector: Existing COW.GcUtil.Collect(ManualGCReason.MemoryUtilCollect), only outside GUI with measured pressure and cooldown.
guiRecovery: Snapshot errors return before latching MzInGui; cleanup resets guard before native GUI restore; both failure paths and following launcher frame executed by pinned VM.
